data_product_description: Monitor prescription items dispensed and fees paid to contractors across practices and regions. Use the data to understand trends, check payments and support effective financial planning.
data_product_overview:

## Data Product Overview
This report visualises the total number of prescription items dispensed and the associated fees paid to contractors, broken down by practice, contractor, and region. It includes metrics such as item counts, professional fees, and comparative trends, providing a clear view of dispensing activity and financial impact. The report is accessible via ePACT2 for authorised users and Catalyst for aggregated insights, ensuring transparency and supporting financial governance.

Purpose:
The report helps NHS England, commissioners, and contractors monitor dispensing volumes and related fees, enabling accurate reimbursement, budget planning, and performance benchmarking. It supports financial accountability and resource allocation.

How to Use:
Users can filter by practice, contractor, or region to review dispensing activity, compare trends, and validate payments. Commissioners use it for audit, cost control, and service planning, while contractors can track their own activity and ensure accurate fee claims. Public users can view aggregated data to understand prescribing and dispensing patterns across regions.
